// The per-tag API differences for v0.91.0: no actorIsMachine argument, no
// internal/identity, and RotateSecret without an actor.
package storage

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/keyorixhq/keyorix/internal/core"
)

func w6AssignUserRole(c *core.KeyorixCore, ctx context.Context, actor, user, role uint, s core.Scope) error {
	return c.AssignUserRole(ctx, actor, user, role, s)
}

func w6AssignGroupRole(c *core.KeyorixCore, ctx context.Context, actor, group, role uint, s core.Scope) error {
	return c.AssignRoleToGroup(ctx, actor, group, role, s)
}

func w6AddGlobal(c *core.KeyorixCore, ctx context.Context, actor, user, group uint) error {
	return c.AddUserToGroupGlobal(ctx, actor, user, group)
}

func w6Rotate(c *core.KeyorixCore, ctx context.Context, id uint, val []byte, actor uint) error {
	_, err := c.RotateSecret(ctx, id, val, "admin")
	return err
}

func w6Fold(string) string { return "" }
